title: REQ · History status is one 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' value with a loading message
summary: A single HistoryStatus type drives a visible loading and error message
description: Context: ContributionSheet has no history status and hides load failures. Desired behavior: a HistoryStatus type 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' held in one useState, written only by the history effect, rendering a loading message while pending and an error message on failure. Expected result: players see what the history is doing. Why: visible loading.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine is pending, When the sheet is open, Then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown
Given listMine resolves, When status becomes ready, Then the loading message is gone and entries are listed
Given listMine rejects, When status becomes error, Then 'Could not load your suggestions' is shown in role=alert

in_scope: HistoryStatus type and render of loading/error messages

technical_constraints: Single useState<HistoryStatus>; no second boolean flag
